_comment: Illustrative policy intent, not a verified current Kilo schema. The administrator must translate and validate this against the deployed extension, then lock the custom provider through %ProgramData%/kilo/kilo.json. The API key is the per-install local gate token, provisioned separately, never a Claude subscription or cloud key. The administrator must also set KILO_DISABLE_SESSION_INGEST=true and VS Code TelemetryLevel=off. Disable the Kilo gateway and Claude Code providers and disable autocomplete: autocomplete uses Kilo's own gateway and bypasses this gate. Windows has no Kilo sandbox.
